signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: Start your free Contentor platform in under 5 minutes.
signup.brandStepSubhead: This is what your students will see — you can always change it later.
signup.nameKeep: Pick one, or press Continue to keep your name as it is.
signup.contactStepHeading: Where should we send your link?
signup.contactStepSubhead: We'll email you a link to verify and start building.
signup.verifyDescription: We sent a verification link to {email}. Click the link to finish setting up your account.
signup.spamHint: Can't find it? Check your spam folder.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.

verify.verifyingSubtitle: Please wait while we verify your email address.
verify.provisioningSubtitle: This usually takes less than a minute.
verify.readySubtitle: Next, we'll build your course and every page together, with AI doing the heavy lifting. It takes about ten minutes.

errors.setupFailed: Setup failed. Please try again or contact support.
errors.slow: Your site is taking longer than usual to get ready. Reload this page in a minute to continue.

resume.title: Your setup link expired
resume.subtitle: No worries — everything you picked is saved. Get a fresh link by email and continue right where you left off.
resume.sentSubtitle: Check your inbox — the new link takes you straight back to your setup.
resume.closedTitle: Your platform is already set up
resume.closedSubtitle: This signup was already completed. Log in to continue.
resume.failed: We couldn't send a link for this signup. Please start again.

signup.authSubtitle: You're signed in as {name} — no email verification needed. Just name your new platform.

login.title: Platform Admin
login.subtitle: Sign in to manage your platform.
login.checkInbox: We sent a link to {email}. Click it to sign in.
